Name: Tem Sword
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
My 6 year old made a mod for a rainbow sword, modeled after the Tem items from Undertale, for which I am very proud of him. He did all of the pixel art, content.json, and manifest.json editing himself. Someday he make a whole armory, but for now, here is your rainbow 999 damage cheat sword.

There is no way to obtain this sword outside of using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] or similar.

Manifest.Name: Tem Sword
Manifest.Description: Puts an OP Tem sword in the game.
